$description: Project configuration for the token sync pipeline. Defines brands, themes, Figma mapping, and platform output.

roles.$description: Maps semantic colour roles to primitive palette names per brand. Roles are fixed; the primitive behind them is flexible.

figma.$description: Figma file and Variable Collection configuration.
figma.$note: Semantic collection uses combined modes: 'Default/Light', 'Default/Dark', etc.

platforms.$description: Output configuration per target platform. Path tokens support {brand} and {theme} placeholders.

css.$description: CSS custom properties. Import in web projects. Supports data-attribute theming.

js.$description: ES module with named exports. Use in React, Vue, Svelte etc.

ts.$description: TypeScript with full type definitions. Import for type-safe token access.

dart.$description: Dart constants for Flutter. Enable when building a Flutter app.

swift.$description: Swift constants for iOS/macOS native apps.
